name: Eval Drift Sentry
one_liner: Reruns a pinned eval subset whenever an upstream model version silently changes, alerting ML platform teams before drift reaches production.

mechanism.actor: ML platform teams maintaining internal eval suites against hosted LLM APIs
mechanism.trigger: an upstream provider ships a new model build under the same API alias
steps: Pin a versioned subset of the team's eval suite and record baseline scores for the current model build
Poll provider changelogs and response version headers nightly, diffing against the recorded baseline configuration
Rerun the pinned subset when a version change lands and compute per-task score deltas
Open a tracker issue with the failing task diffs when any delta exceeds the team's threshold
mechanism.replaces_workaround: Teams keep ad-hoc prompt spreadsheets and rerun them by hand after users report degraded outputs in production

why_now.change: Provider changelogs and model version response headers became machine-readable during 2025, making silent model swaps detectable without scraping

descriptor.target_actor: ML platform teams at LLM-consuming companies
descriptor.workflow: regression-testing hosted model behavior after upstream changes
descriptor.bottleneck: silent upstream model swaps invalidate cached eval results
descriptor.trust_requirement: read access to eval suite and CI, no production data needed

closest_prior_art.name: promptfoo
closest_prior_art.difference: Runs evals on demand in CI; does not watch provider version metadata or trigger reruns on upstream swaps

closest_prior_art.name: LangSmith monitoring
closest_prior_art.difference: Monitors live traffic quality downstream; does not pin an eval subset keyed to provider build identifiers

queries: eval rerun on provider version change tool
model version pinned regression testing service
recheck.note: Second pass with reframed queries found CI-triggered eval runners but nothing keyed to provider build identifiers

kill_tests.note: Requires maintained per-provider version fingerprinting, an ongoing data chore incumbents have declined
Platform teams already pay for eval tooling line items
Major providers shipped silent revisions multiple times per quarter in the observed period
Distribution through the existing regression tracker subscriber list
Falls back to response-hash sampling if providers drop version headers

edge.asset: A two-year corpus of per-version eval deltas collected in a public regression tracker the user maintains, with 400 subscribers
edge.control: The tracker repository and its subscriber list are owned and operated by the user under an open license they control
edge.copy_difficulty: The historical delta corpus cannot be backfilled; a copier starts with zero history and zero subscriber trust
edge.proof_metric: Subscriber-to-paid conversion above 5 percent within the first 90 days of a paid tier

falsification.test: Publish a manual drift-alert digest for two providers for four weeks and measure signups against the tracker audience
falsification.cost: roughly 20 hours of manual effort, no capital
falsification.kill_condition: Fewer than 25 signups from 400 subscribers, or providers announce first-party version-pinned eval reruns
